name: ANSI/IEEE Six-phase polygon winding connection form
summary: IEEE-library form of six-phase polygon winding connection: a polygon winding qualifier identifies the publisher's six-phase polygon connection.
description: This reference locates six-phase polygon winding connection in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented winding family. A polygon winding qualifier identifies the publisher's six-phase polygon connection. The public library uses Q060211 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
